our_takes.our-take: The DCS Ultimate Platinum UnionPay Card is best for those who want a flat cashback rate without minimum spending requirements. You'll earn 2% cashback on all spend, capped at S$200 monthly – useful for consistent rewards across varied expenses. UnionPay QR acceptance gives added convenience both locally and overseas. Note the S$196.20 annual fee (waived first year) & the late payment fee of S$100, which makes responsible spending essential. Consider other cards if you prefer category-specific bonuses, as this card offers a uniform rate.
our_takes.good-for:
Salaried professionals seeking generous cashback of up to 2% on all spends, both locally and overseas with no minimum spending.
UnionPay users who want to conveniently scan and pay at QR code-enabled merchants worldwide, including China, Hong Kong and Thailand.
our_takes.things-to-note:
The 26.90% annual interest rate can be costly; unpaid balances quickly accumulate, making repayment significantly harder.
Late payment fees of S$100 apply if minimum payments aren't met, adding a substantial charge to your outstanding balance.
While the first year's annual fee is waived, after that it's S$196.20; evaluate if rewards offset this cost.
